assign.outcome:
**The site is better — narrowly and provably. `78 → 83` measured the seat's own drift, not the site: 3 real regressions, all one rule, against 4 real fixes.**

![](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/layout-primitives/after-3440.png)

**Why the count is noise.** The sweep shot `/framework/ui/`@1280 and `/framework/ai/2026-08-17/`@1280 **twice each**, nine minutes apart — same model, same prompt, same unchanged page. Both drifted **+1 broken**, and agreed on about one finding in five (**zero** broken findings in common on the second pair). ±1 per page-width is the floor, ±3 per page. Deduped the corpus is **74 → 83**, and the note's table is off: `ui/` is 5→3 not 7→3, `ai/2026-08-17/` is **3→3** not 5→3.

| | count | what |
|---|---|---|
| **Real regressions** | **3** | one rule — `framework.css:274` |
| **Real fixes** | **4** | `--pad-y` ×2 · `.muted` 75% · `code-inline` |

Same 3-and-4 twice: rolled up from the corpus, and summed from the per-page lines.

**The regression** — wave 3's `code-inline`: `code { background: var(--wash) }` on top of `code { padding: .15em .4em }`. `--wash` is `#f2f2f2`, a card is `#fff`, and `.app` **is** `--wash` — so the chip is invisible and its padding reads as a naked space. `Item 's own record` · `Doc  with  Doc .` · `View , Page ,`. The trade was still favourable (22 "heaviest element on the page" findings gone); the chip just needs a hairline. Revert is one line.

**And the site changed under the measurement:** `ui/` −4 and `ai/…-17/` −2 are `ui-wall`'s 19:55 rebuild and `task-status`, not CSS. `/web/` 5→1 is **1 real fix and 3 of the same defects demoted `broken` → `maybe`**.

[**The verdict, the ledger and wave 4**](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/remeasure-diff/proposal.md) — every new `broken` on the eight pages classified, then six items, cause → fix → class: the `code` chip · `wide` still reaches nothing (12 of 19 pages, one word in `AITask.js:76`) · tabs still clip at the **left** edge · unframed panels outside `.page-preview` · the `mastermind-shots` table header · **shoot every page-width twice**.

**Left:** nothing was fixed — the brief said judge, not repair. [`after-3440.png`](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/layout-primitives/after-3440.png) is regenerated from the current CSS, so it is a **wave-3 "after"**, not wave 1's; its `web` tile is `/web/` (the original shot `/framework/web/` and captured its 404) and `ui` is the rebuilt wall.
